verdict.rationale: Homebrew documents an opt-out for its anonymous aggregate analytics (`brew analytics off`). That stops data collection, which is an adjacent control and not a user-facing way to set retention periods or delete data already collected, so it earns no credit for this story. No evidence shows retention settings, deletion requests, or purging of previously sent analytics. Missing for 10: documented data-retention controls, a user-initiated deletion mechanism for collected analytics data, and independent corroboration of either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
